paper.title: Parallel Scan Recurrent Neural Quantum States for Scalable Variational Monte Carlo
paper.authors: Ejaaz Merali, Mohamed Hibat-Allah, Mohammad Kohandel, Richard T. Scalettar, Ehsan Khatami

results.system_description: Heisenberg, 10 × 10 · J = 1 · open · Sz = 0. H = sum_<ij> S_i · S_j; S = sigma/2
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of the authors' 2D minGRU; the PEPS, PixelCNN and 2D TRNN columns are quoted from other papers and the QMC column is a reference.
results.notes: Open boundaries, H = sum S_i · S_j with S = sigma/2 (Sec. 'Square Lattice Heisenberg model'). The caption gives about 7.1 million parameters. The positive recurrent amplitude is combined with the Marshall sign rule, exact for this model, as for the other recurrent-network entries on these instances. The magnetization sector is not stated.
